storyCards.fact:
Vandenberg's "Burning Heart" reached #39 on the Billboard Hot 100. Adriaan van den Berg (born 31 January 1954), known as Adrian "Adje" Vandenberg, is a Dutch rock guitarist, best known for his tenure as one of the guitarists in Whitesnake during their successful late 1980s period and the band Vandenberg which he started in 1981.

The song peaked at #39 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 14 weeks on the chart.

Burning Heart was released in 1983.
